note: Value-gap risk drivers for red/critical customers — what the customer was sold on / expected (sales call + HubSpot purpose), where they are today, and the roadblocks between. Sourced from HubSpot churn-assessment notes + Fireflies calls. Overlaid on the signal baseline by build_churn_risk_matrix.mjs. Keyed by allmoxy_customer_id. Maintained in-session (MCP connectors can't run headless). For expected_value, 'sales call not captured' means the original demo/sales call wasn't found in Fireflies — review manually or infer from context.
